summary: The complete legal domain has only 5800 scalar input pairs, while the reference performs a fixed number of arithmetic and conditional operations, so runtime scaling cannot honestly distinguish a smaller class.

workload_bound.source_constraint: money is between 1 and 200 inclusive and children is between 2 and 30 inclusive

replacement_checks.evidence: The reference uses one subtraction, one division, a constant number of multiplications or comparisons, and at most one correction; it contains no input-dependent loop or allocation.
An independent bitset dynamic program enumerated feasible recipient counts and eight-dollar counts for all 5800 legal (money, children) pairs and matched the reference result.
